title: Automatic text classification of actionable radiology reports of tinnitus patients using bidirectional encoder representations from transformer (BERT) and in-domain pre-training (IDPT).
summary: A BERT classifier with in-domain pretraining sorted tinnitus-related radiology reports by whether they contained actionable findings, supporting follow-up prioritization in the evaluated health-system records. This is a retrospective text-classification result, not evidence of improved patient outcomes.
